title: Unbiased Hamiltonian Simulation by Reversing Trotter Error Dynamics
summary: Owing to their simplicity and low overhead, Suzuki-Trotter formulas remain the de facto Hamiltonian simulation methods on current quantum computing platforms. Systematic Trotter errors, however, will quickly become limiting when scaling to larger problems and aiming for higher accuracy. We present a mechanism that removes the systematic error of any $k$-th order Suzuki-Trotter simulation, at the cost of a constant sampling overhead.
